summary: Completed comprehensive testing of CRM application with location tracking. Fixed 1 backend bug. All 28 backend API tests pass. All frontend UI tests pass including login, registration, dashboard, location tracking, and logout flows.

fixed.issue: 500 Internal Server Error - AttributeError: '_asyncio.Future' object has no attribute 'sort'. The find_one().sort() pattern doesn't work with Motor async driver.

integration_issues.issue: WebSocket connection to wss://...preview.emergentagent.com/ws/locations fails with 'WebSocket is closed before the connection is established'. This is likely due to the preview environment's ingress not supporting WebSocket upgrades properly.
integration_issues.note: Real-time updates may not work in preview environment but the REST API fallback works correctly

action_items: WebSocket connection issue in preview environment - may need to configure ingress for WebSocket support or implement polling fallback
